postings.title: Senior Manager, Accounting
postings.text:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.



But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.



We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As Headway's Senior Accounting Manager, you will lead day-to-day accounting operations and help establish scalable financial processes during a period of rapid growth. You'll manage a team of four accountants, owning month-end close, financial reporting, and technical accounting under US GAAP. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll coach a high-performing team while partnering cross-functionally with Finance, People, Legal, Data, Product, and Engineering to ensure accurate and timely reporting. This role offers an opportunity to apply strong leadership, technical accounting expertise, and creative problem-solving to make a lasting impact on Headway's operations and audit readiness.


YOU WILL:

 - Manage and develop a team of 3+ accountants — setting priorities, reviewing work, providing feedback, and coaching them on technical accounting and process improvements.

 - Take a lead in automating accounting workflows using AI and LLMs (e.g., journal entry preparation, reconciliations, flux analysis, audit support), and lead the team in adopting these tools responsibly.

 - Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close process end-to-end, ensuring journal entries, reconciliations, accruals, and account analyses are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.

 - Review and approve journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and flux analyses prepared by the team.

 - Lead technical accounting research and policy setting under US GAAP, including documenting accounting positions and memos for complex transactions

 - Support the annual audit by coordinating PBC requests and responses across the team, partnering with the Assistant Controller (who serves as the primary point of contact for external auditors.)

 - Partner with the People team to oversee payroll accounting and reconciliations, and with cross-functional teams (Finance, Data, Engineering, Product) to scale accounting operations.

 - Drive process improvements and automation initiatives across the accounting function, leveraging tools like Netsuite, Workday, and Ramp to reduce manual work and improve controls.

 - Lead or sponsor strategic accounting projects, coordinating cross-functional partners and delivering measurable business impact.


YOU'D BE GREAT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - 10+ years of accounting and/or audit experience, including at least 5 years managing a team

 - A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or another relevant field (CPA preferred but not required)

 - Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and experience leading month-end close in a high-growth environment

 - Public accounting (Big 4 or large firm) and/or in-house experience at a high-growth or pre-IPO company

 - History of utilizing LLM’s such as Claude to automate processes.

 - A track record of coaching and developing accounting talent

 - Hands-on experience with Netsuite (and ideally Numeric and Ramp), and a bias toward using technology to scale accounting operations

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner effectively across functions

 - A proactive, ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

postings.title: Strategic Finance Manager
postings.text:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.



But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.



We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.



Strategic Finance Manager

As we scale towards $1B+ in revenue — connecting patients to mental healthcare and building the infrastructure that makes that possible at scale — Strategic Finance is one of the most operationally influential seats in the company. The decisions that shape how we grow, where we invest, and how we measure success run through this team. Strategic Finance exists at Headway to make better decisions regarding where to put the next dollar and then to make sure we actually execute against those decisions.

You'll be a true business partner to leaders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, People, and other corporate functions — close enough to their work to understand what actually drives results, and rigorous enough to translate that into forecasts, unit economics, and business cases that hold up. You'll own core parts of our planning and forecasting rhythm, and you'll be the person leadership turns to when a decision needs a clear-eyed financial answer.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who thrives at the intersection of financial analysis and strategic decision-making. We're looking for someone who wants to influence outcomes, not just report on them.

You will:

 - Partner with the business: Serve as an embedded finance business partner to 1-2 functions. You are responsible for translating business plans into financial plans and financial constraints into business tradeoffs.

 - Drive capital allocation: Build and pressure-test business cases for investments —  these could range across product bets, sales and marketing, market expansion, headcount, vendor, or build-vs-buy decisions. You’ll track outcomes and unit economics, closing the loop with leadership on what worked.

 - Own planning & budgeting: Run the financial planning and monthly forecasting process end-to-end. Manage the operating budget with your partner teams — monthly reviews, variance analysis, and guidance.

 - Maintain forecasts and KPIs: Own and continuously improve understanding of the drivers of your part of the business. Help the business define the KPIs that matter and then work with Data to make them visible and trusted.

 - Bring AI into the workflow: Actively apply AI tools to drive faster insight, greater efficiency, and smarter decision-making — and help shape how the Finance team works as those tools evolve.

You'd be a great fit if:

 - You're excited to join a mission-driven company and use your financial skills to help scale access to mental healthcare.

 - You have 6+ years of experience, ideally blending Investment Banking, Consulting, or Private Equity/Venture Capital with a highly analytical Strategic Finance role at a fast-growing tech company.

 - You've owned the numbers or been a critical financial partner to a fast-growing business or product line. 

 - You make the business better, not just the model. You embed with business partners, earn their trust quickly, and translate financial analysis into decisions that sharpen strategy and drive results.

 - You bring structure to ambiguity. You proactively seek context, solve open-ended problems, anticipate stakeholder needs, and stay flexible when priorities shift.

 - You communicate complex insights clearly. You tailor your message to the audience — finance vs. business partners — and make the takeaway impossible to miss.

 - You see AI as a competitive advantage, not a feature to explore someday. You actively use AI tools to be more efficient, sharpen your analysis, and make smarter calls.

About the role:
Headway is seeking an AP Manager to own the accounts payable function and build scalable, efficient processes that support accurate financial reporting and audit readiness. In this role, you’ll manage AP operations, month-end close, reconciliations, and audit support while partnering cross-functionally to optimize workflows and vendor management. This is a great opportunity for a hands-on, detail-oriented individual to drive accuracy, efficiency, and scalability across the AP function. 

You will:

 - Lead end-to-end AP operations including invoice processing, approvals, payments, accruals, and prepaids to ensure timely and accurate posting to the GL.

 - Own month-end and year-end close procedures for AP, including reconciliations and cut-off controls, reducing post-close adjustments and supporting a clean trial balance.

 - Prepare, review, and maintain audit-ready PBCs and serve as the primary AP subject matter expert for external auditors such as KPMG.

 - Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to scale AP workflows, reduce manual effort, and strengthen internal controls.

 - Partner with Corporate Accounting and FP&A to support accrual accuracy, cash forecasting, and timely resolution of vendor issues.

 - Build standardized AP procedures and expectations, with future opportunity to mentor and manage additional AP resources as the function scales.

 - Enhance automation and process efficiency by leveraging AI tools to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy and scalability across operations

You’d be a great fit if:

 - You have 7+ years of accounting experience with 3+ years managing AP operations in a high-growth or complex environment (healthcare, fintech, or SaaS preferred).

 - Proven experience with month-end/year-end close, reconciliations, and audit support.

 - Strong knowledge of AP-related US GAAP (expense recognition, accruals, prepaids) and internal controls.

 - Hands-on operator who can implement scalable processes and drive automation initiatives.

 - Excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills, able to collaborate with cross-functional partners and vendors.

 - Passionate about building reliable, efficient AP processes and developing team capabilities.

 - Hands-on experience with NetSuite and Ramp, with the ability to optimize workflows and reporting within these systems.

 - A curiosity into using AI tools and a dedication to leveraging AI for process automation and efficiency.

Compensation and Benefits:

The expected base pay range for this position is $110,400- $172,500, based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an equity grant, depending on the position and level.

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.

 - Benefits offered include:
   
   - Equity compensation
   
   - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
   
   - HSA / FSA
   
   - 401K
   
   - Work-from-Home Stipend
   
   - Therapy Reimbursement
   
   - 16-week parental leave for eligible employees
   
   - Carrot Fertility annual reimbursement and membership
   
   - 13 paid holidays each year as well as a Holiday Break during the week between December 25th and December 31st
   
   - Flexible PTO
   
   - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
   
   - Training and professional development
